svg.text: HE₁₁ of a silica strand of 0.3 µm radius in air at 800 nm, solved exactly: the field
is not truncated, and its exterior tail is integrated to a declared outer radius.
E_t, H_t continuous at r = a;
radial D continuous, so radial E jumps
= a max(2, 1 + ln 10⁸ / w), off the page
the field is frozen in frequency
